description: This file contains unit tests and grain implementations for Orleans persistence mechanisms, including various grain classes, state classes, and serialization helpers used in testing persistence and serialization features.

classes.name: TestRuntimeEnvironmentUtility
classes.description: Utility class for capturing runtime environment details during tests.

classes.name: PersistenceGenericGrainState<T>
classes.description: Generic class representing persistent grain state with a key of type T.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGrain
classes.description: Grain implementation for testing persistence with specific storage provider.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGenericGrain<T>
classes.description: Generic grain class extending PersistenceTestGrain for testing generic state persistence.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderErrorGrain
classes.description: Grain that simulates persistence errors for testing error handling.

classes.name: PersistenceUserHandledErrorGrain
classes.description: Grain that handles persistence errors internally with logging and recovery.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderErrorProxyGrain
classes.description: Proxy grain to delegate calls to other persistence grains, used for testing.

classes.name: PersistenceErrorGrain
classes.description: Grain that intentionally throws errors during persistence operations for testing.

classes.name: BadProviderTestGrain
classes.description: Grain configured with a missing storage provider to test error scenarios.

classes.name: PersistenceNoStateTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with no persistent state, used for testing behavior without state.

classes.name: ServiceIdGrain
classes.description: Grain that provides the service ID from cluster options.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrain
classes.description: Grain testing grain storage with specific provider.

classes.name: GrainStorageGenericGrain<T>
classes.description: Generic grain for testing storage with generic state.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrainExtendedKey
classes.description: Grain testing storage with extended key support.

classes.name: MemoryStorageTestGrain
classes.description: Grain testing in-memory storage, including nested state class.

classes.name: UserGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing IUser interface, managing user state and friends.

classes.name: StateForIReentrentGrain
classes.description: State class for reentrant grain with multiple dictionaries and integers.

classes.name: ReentrentGrainWithState
classes.description: Reentrant grain with complex state management and concurrency control.

classes.name: InternalGrainStateData
classes.description: Simple internal state class with a single integer field.

classes.name: InternalGrainWithState
classes.description: Internal grain with state, supporting setting a single value.

classes.name: BaseStateData
classes.description: Interface for grain state data, not using IGrainState directly.

classes.name: StateInheritanceTestGrainData
classes.description: State class inheriting from IBaseStateData with additional fields.

classes.name: StateInheritanceTestGrain
classes.description: Grain testing state inheritance and access.

classes.name: SurrogateStateForTypeWithoutPublicConstructorGrain
classes.description: Grain handling surrogate serialization for types without public constructors.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructor
classes.description: Type with private constructor and static factory method, used for surrogate testing.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructorSurrogate
classes.description: Serializer surrogate for ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructor.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructorSurrogateConverter
classes.description: Converter between ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructor and its surrogate.

classes.name: RecordTypeWithoutPublicParameterlessConstructorGrain
classes.description: Grain handling surrogate serialization for record types without parameterless constructor.

classes.name: RecordTypeWithoutPublicParameterlessConstructor
classes.description: Record type with a single property, used for surrogate serialization testing.
